messages:
olivia_recon: FYI found a consumption gap for BrightLoop after last week's rate-limiter rollout. Customer reported fewer billable tokens than expected. I dug in and see a bunch of successful 2xx responses from edge but those requests never made it into the metering topic.

greg_bill: how big is "fewer"? ballpark $ or %? need to triage for invoices cut yesterday.

olivia_recon: ~9,200 embed units missing for month-to-date (approx $920). It's isolated to a retry suppression flow where the SDK client got a 429 but local retry-suppression marked it as dropped and returned cached success to app. Edge returned 200 to the client but we didn't emit meter event.

devon_platform: confirmed. logs show spike of `retry_suppressed=true` around 2027-11-03T02:14Z on node cluster-7. Example log:

```
2027-11-03T02:14:08Z node=cluster-7 request_id=abcd1234 status=200 retry_suppressed=true emit_meter=false
```

devon_platform: quick SQL to compute delta: 
```
-- approximate missing embed_units
SELECT customer_id, sum(expected_embed_count) - sum(emitted_embed_count) as missing_units
FROM metering_snapshot
WHERE bucket >= '2027-11-01' AND bucket < '2027-11-08' AND node = 'cluster-7'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```

aisha_fin: thanks. do we have invoice(s) already sent to BrightLoop? if yes we either adjust or issue a credit.

sam_support: BrightLoop invoices were sent yesterday (invoice #BL-20271102). Support already got a note from the customer complaining about usage mismatch.

greg_bill: ok we need exact delta and a proposed credit. olivia, can you run the recount SQL and put numbers here? also flag if this is one-off vs ongoing.

olivia_recon: running now. ETA 20m. initial estimate was conservative; recount job shows missing_units = 9278 embed_units => ~$927. Not recurring; caused by rollout config that suppressed retry emissions for 36m.

metering-bot: Alert: deployment rollback performed on cluster-7 at 2027-11-03T02:51Z (rollback cause: replayed metering mismatch).

devon_platform: yeah we rolled back the rate-limiter flag to previous behavior. root cause: the SDK-level suppression short-circuited our emitter hook. I've prepared a backfill job that will read raw request logs and emit meter events for missing request_ids. backfill will run as a batch with id BF-3789. Estimated run time 2-3 hours, will emit ~9.3k units.

aisha_fin: if backfill emits events before EOD we can include adjustment in next day's invoice run. If not, finance needs to prepare a manual credit. What's the worst-case $ exposure? greg?

greg_bill: worst-case if backfill fails and we credit fully it's $927 + small rounding. approve provisional credit up to $1,100 for BL-20271102 if backfill not completed by EOD. aisha please confirm approval flow.

aisha_fin: approved. I'll need a brief description + amount and the invoice id to create credit memo. please add to billing-adjustments board and link PR.

olivia_recon: added JIRA FIN-1127 with reproducer notes, SQL used, and logs. backfill job BF-3789 started at 2027-11-03T04:10Z. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-1127

sam_support: customer update draft: "Thanks — we found a transient metering issue caused by our rate-limiter rollout that undercounted a portion of your embedding usage. We're backfilling the missing events and will issue a credit if the backfill can't be applied before your next invoice. Estimated impact: ~$927." ok to send once backfill completes/if fails?

greg_bill: send that now with an "investigating" subject, good to preempt. include expected timeline 2-3 hours.

devon_platform: backfill progress: 40% complete (approx 3,700 units emitted). no failures so far.

olivia_recon: backfill completed at 2027-11-03T06:12Z. emitted 9,278 units. meter topic shows emissions reconciled.

metering-bot: Recon job BF-3789: success. reconciled_units=9278.

aisha_fin: since backfill succeeded, no manual credit required. closing FIN-1127 as resolved. I've updated invoice notes with reconciliation reference BL-20271102-RCONC and will attach the JIRA link.

greg_bill: great. two action items: 1) devon, add a unit test for emitter hook so SDK suppression paths still emit metering; 2) olivia, run a weekly sanity query across other clusters for similar windows for next 2 weeks.

devon_platform: on it, will open a PR this morning.

olivia_recon: will schedule weekly checks. thanks all.

sam_support: sent the customer update they approved. they replied :thumbsup:.
